messages:
sam: Starting schema migration rollout (index+backfill) to prod-canary at 2026-03-21T15:12:31Z. Will follow canary -> staged -> ramp plan.
li: quick note: preflight should have locked autoscale off for canary during index apply. did that run?
sam: preflight flagged, but the autoscale toggle wasn't applied due to a config sync hiccup. i pinned service to v3-canary manually.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by @sam. Steps queued: 1) online-index-create 2) backfill-async 3) promote-canary-traffic
db-eng: after index start, replica-2 reporting higher wal_sender backlog and replica_io waiting. digging into WAL activity
sre-oncall: getting alerts for replica lag > 60s on replica-2. can we throttle the index?
li: we can pause remaining staged rollouts and reduce maintenance_work_mem for index process. also lower checkpoint_timeout to avoid big WAL bursts
sam: pause remaining stages please. deploy-bot, hold stage jobs -> `deploy-bot hold 1777001111-stages`
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged for staged jobs by @sam.
product-ops: tagging release notes: "Canary index applied; paused due to replica lag. Investigating replica IO and autoscale interaction."
db-eng: suggested mitigation: run lag-catchup on replica-2 and restart wal receiver. command we use:
```
ssh db-admin@replica-2 'pg_ctl restart -D /var/lib/postgres/data && pg_rewind --target-pgdata=/var/lib/postgres/data --source-server="host=leader user=repuser"'
```
(we prefer soft restart first)
tara: also creating a temporary feature flag to limit background backfill concurrency: `ff:set backfill_concurrency=1`
li: also altering psql session for the index process: `SET maintenance_work_mem = '128MB'; SET max_parallel_workers = 2;` to limit resource footprint
sre-oncall: extending migration window by +45m in calendar and alerting on-call rope. marking incident channel if lag > 180s
sam: if catchup fails we'll execute rollback plan: revert index creation (DROP INDEX if partial) and replay from snapshot. db-eng, confirm rollback steps?
db-eng: yes. rollback plan B:
1) pause writes to table via feature toggle
2) DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_new_feature
3) restore replica from latest consistent snapshot (if necessary)
4) validate replication health
li: i've updated the release doc: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-schema-v3. added a note about pinning autoscale for future runs
deploy-bot: Staged jobs paused. To resume run `deploy-bot resume <thread_ts>`
sam: running catchup now. i'll update here when replica lag <10s. thanks all for quick responses :pray:
li: will watch PG metrics and SLO dashboards
sre-oncall: added temporary alert rule to page at 120s+ lag.
tara: backfill concurrency flag set to 1 and confirmed in env via `ff:status backfill_concurrency`
db-eng: catchup finished. replica-2 lag steady ~4s after restart and rewind.
sam: ok let's resume at 1% traffic with throttling. deploy-bot, resume 1777001111 -> `deploy-bot resume 1777001111 1%`
deploy-bot: Resume acknowledged. Traffic set to 1% and concurrency caps applied.
li: monitoring WAL emission and checkpoint spikes. initial 20m look ok.
product-ops: updating release notes: added post-incident action item to fix config sync for autoscale toggle and to add preflight check for autoscale-disabled during index apply
sre-oncall: will keep watch for next 2 hours and then we can ramp further if stable
sam: closing holdpoint. follow-up: short postmortem to be added and a runbook update for future builds. thanks everyone.
